'''Imperial Military Command''' was a military command element of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The unit had personnel stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during [[Invasion of Taris|its invasion]] by the Sith Empire in [[3642 BBY]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Dominating Taris|Taris}}</ref>
